purpose: Let external guardrails emit compact Agent Fables evidence breadcrumbs without delegating authorization or copying corpus prose.
producer_rules: emit only after a local detector maps a condition to a known AF identifier
use a generic detector label; never include matched content, paths, hostnames, credentials, or raw commands
pin the corpus revision used for the mapping
never translate a finding or an empty result into execution authorization
consumer_rules: treat the finding as evidence with authority none
resolve the canonical URL or installed record when more provenance is needed
require host-owned verification and authorization separately
do not infer safety from no finding
